generic_monodromy_theorem.analytic_statement: There exists epsilon>0 such that 0<|hbar|<epsilon and exp(4*pi*i*hbar) of infinite order imply monodromy closure GL(5,C).
generic_monodromy_theorem.formal_monodromy_zariski_closure: GL(5) over the algebraic closure of C((hbar))
generic_monodromy_theorem.pointwise_differential_galois_consequenc: GL(5,C) for the same small infinite-order specializations, by regular-singular Schlesinger density
proof_steps: Local nonresonant Frobenius bases and their connection matrix Phi(hbar) are analytic near0, with Phi(0)=I.
Common conjugation gives local generators exp(2*pi*i*hbar*A) and Phi(hbar)^(-1) exp(2*pi*i*hbar*B) Phi(hbar).
An infinite-order exp(4*pi*i*hbar) makes each local cyclic closure its integer-weight one-dimensional torus; its Lie algebra contains A or Phi^(-1)B Phi.
The recorded25 Lie words evaluated on A and Phi^(-1)B Phi have nonzero determinant at hbar0; their determinant is a formal unit and remains nonzero on some analytic neighborhood.
The group Lie algebra is gl5, so its Zariski closure equals the connected25-dimensional group GL5.

linear_form_certificate.distinction: X^t G=GX is selfadjointness; X^t G+GX=0 is infinitesimal invariance
